title: Expiration of registration
bodyText: . Registrations shall expire on December 31 of each odd-numbered year. The expiration date of the registration shall appear on the appraisal management company registration certificate issued to the registrant, and no other notice of its expiration need be given to the registrant.
bodyHtml: [§466M-10]  Expiration of registration.  Registrations shall expire on December 31 of each odd-numbered year.  The expiration date of the registration shall appear on the appraisal management company registration certificate issued to the registrant, and no other notice of its expiration need be given to the registrant. [L 2024, c 80, pt of §2]
